description: Strategy library v1. Every entry is a PROPOSAL. No strategy is validated yet - all fail gates G-0..G-6 until backtests and forward records exist. Nothing here is a betting recommendation.

signals.name: Line-move vs news sync
signals.definition: A market line moved >= 3 points between open and current AND the move is time-aligned with a verified injury/status announcement for that game.
signals.data_needed: timestamped odds, official injury report timestamps
signals.example_this_week: BAL-CAR Wk11: BAL open -4.5 flipped to CAR -1.5 after Nov 13 Lamar Jackson 6-10 week report (see odds_week11.json)

signals.name: Backup-cluster deficiency
signals.definition: A position group with 2+ unavailable players (Out/Doubtful/IR) or a chart-verified 2nd/3rd/4th stringer pressed into the top 2 strings on one side of the ball.
signals.example_this_week: BAL QB: 3 on IR, 2nd-string Brissett starting (depth.json); CAR CB: 4 unavailable (deficiencies.json)

signals.name: Pythagorean luck delta
signals.definition: Teams whose actual wins differ from Pythagorean expected wins by >= 1.5 games are regression candidates (definition only - not a bet signal until gate G-7 passes).
signals.example_this_week: DEN +2.17, BUF +1.58, CLE +1.53 over; TB -2.17, LAC -1.57, TEN -1.54 under (luck.json)

signals.name: Market gap (model vs market)
signals.definition: Model v0.1 spread differs from market by >= 3 points. NOT an edge claim - v0.1 has no injury inputs; gaps often reflect missing information (see LAC-BAL).
signals.example_this_week: JAX-TEN gap -8.0; LAC-BAL gap +4.5 (model unaware Lamar is out)

signals.name: Neutral-site HFA mispricing
signals.definition: International/neutral games have no established HFA; market convention vs model HFA=0 creates systematic gaps.
signals.example_this_week: NE-DET Munich Wk10; MIN-SF Mexico City Wk11 SNF
signals.state: flagged - no verified neutral HFA value (F-07)

signals.name: Totals deflation with offensive attrition
signals.definition: Games where both teams lost starting QB/WR/TE/OL production show open-to-current total drops; the size of the drop vs historical response curves is the potential edge.
signals.example_this_week: LAC-BAL total 48.5 -> 38.5 after Lamar news; MIA-IND 47.5 -> 38.5

signals.name: Rest/look-ahead spot
signals.definition: Team on post-bye or short-week scheduling asymmetry with lineup instability.
signals.example_this_week: PIT off Wk9 bye into SNF at CIN; LAC on MNF short week to Wk11 vs NYJ

signals.name: Backup-cluster defensive prop attack
signals.definition: Player prop combos targeting offenses facing defenses missing 2+ secondary players (yards/attempt, deep completions).
signals.data_needed: prop lines (MISSING - no source yet), snap counts (missing), play-by-play (missing)
signals.state: BLOCKED - no verified prop data source (Q-06)
signals.note: Source is null because no verified player-prop source exists yet (Q-06) - this is the flag, not an omission.

strategies.name: Deficiency fade/attack singles
strategies.hypothesis: Sides/totals adjusted AFTER verified lineup deficiencies are priced slowly relative to true impact.

strategies.name: Model-market gap v0.1
strategies.hypothesis: Persistent gaps between originated lines and market at close contain information.

strategies.name: Regression singles (luck delta)
strategies.hypothesis: Pythagorean underperformers cover more than break-even when facing overperformers, after vig.

strategies.name: Correlated same-game parlay (spread+total)
strategies.hypothesis: Favorite + under legs in games with offensive attrition are positively correlated enough that combined price > product of independent probabilities.
strategies.correlation_policy: S-PARLAY-1: leg pair |r| must be measured and |r| < 0.3 unless the parlay pricing explicitly models the dependency
strategies.state: proposed - blocked until correlation matrix validated (F-08)

strategies.name: Cross-game parlay of uncorrelated singles
strategies.hypothesis: Parlaying independent +EV singles across different games keeps variance structure simple and correlations ~0.
strategies.correlation_policy: S-PARLAY-2: no two legs from the same game; no two legs on the same team; cap 4 legs

strategies.name: Player prop combo vs depleted secondary
strategies.hypothesis: Passing/receiving props correlate with opponent secondary attrition; combos across the same game require explicit joint modeling.
strategies.correlation_policy: S-PROPS-1: same-game prop combos must use a measured joint distribution; independence assumption is FORBIDDEN
strategies.state: BLOCKED - needs prop data source (Q-06) and play-by-play (Q-07)

single.kelly_cap: quarter-Kelly max per pick (policy, pending Q-02 bankroll answers)
